decisions.text: 4 days marked, inside the 3-4 sessions a week for intermediate muscle work; the plan uses all 4.

decisions.text: daily undulating periodization for muscle at intermediate level: rep zones rotate 6-8 / 10-12 across the week. Meta-analyses find linear and undulating models give similar muscle gains, so the choice is a convention.
decisions.say: The block uses daily undulating periodization: rep zones rotate 6-8 / 10-12 across the week. Meta-analyses find linear and undulating models give similar muscle gains, so the choice is a convention.

decisions.text: 8 weeks: a deload in weeks 4 and 8 with 40% less volume.
decisions.say: Across the 8 weeks there is a deload in weeks 4 and 8 with 40% less volume.

decisions.text: knee flag: 3 lifts with deep loaded knee flexion move along the substitution graph: back squat to box squat, above parallel, bulgarian split squat to low-box step-up and leg press to leg press, partial range. Knee joint forces in the squat rise with knee flexion and peak near full flexion, so loaded flexion stays above parallel.
decisions.say: Because of the knee flag, 3 lifts with deep loaded knee flexion change, back squat to box squat, above parallel among them. Knee forces in a squat rise as the knee bends and peak near full depth, so loaded knee flexion stays above parallel.

decisions.text: 60 minutes, less a 7-minute warm-up, holds about 19 main-lift sets at 2 minutes rest each, more when accessories rest 1.5 minutes.
decisions.say: Each 60-minute session holds about 19 heavy sets after a 7-minute warm-up, because main lifts rest 2 minutes between sets.

decisions.text: The solver leaves 7 template slots closed: cable lateral raise, cable triceps pushdown and barbell curl (no minutes left).
decisions.say: The minutes run out before cable lateral raise and cable triceps pushdown, so they stay out of the plan.

decisions.text: Target 10-16 sets per muscle per week. The solver places 68 working sets: 6 of 12 targeted muscles land in range; under target: side delts 3, rear delts 6.5, biceps 7.5, triceps 7.5 and abs 2, because the minutes run out first; chest 9, at the set cap per exercise.
decisions.say: The weekly target is 10 to 16 sets per muscle, and 6 of 12 muscle groups land inside it, while side delts, rear delts and biceps fall short because the minutes run out first.

decisions.text: Session load = session RPE x minutes (AU). Curves: fitness-fatigue model with population defaults k1 = 1, k2 = 2, tau1 = 45 d, tau2 = 15 d; fits in elite swimmers gave 38 d (95% CI 17-59) and 19 d (6-32).
decisions.say: Every session's load is its session RPE times its minutes, and the curves run the fitness-fatigue model on population defaults (45-day fitness and 15-day fatigue time constants) that are not fitted to you.

decisions.text: Variable dose on: the fatigue gain k2 rises with the last few days of load (tau3 = 2.3 d), so a session stacked on hard days costs more fatigue.
decisions.say: With variable dose on, a session stacked on hard days costs more fatigue than the same session after rest.

decisions.text: Model form is lowest in week 3 and peaks on Sun of week 8.
decisions.say: On these defaults your form is lowest in week 3 and highest in week 8, which is where the deload pays off.

decisions.text: Mon of week 3 logged at RPE 9 against a planned 7: 531 AU against 413. The model has you starting Thu 194 AU of form below plan (tolerance 163 AU, half a typical session), so Thu loses one set per exercise and one RPE point.
decisions.say: Mon of week 3 came in at RPE 9 instead of 7, and the load model puts you 194 AU of form below plan going into Thu, more than the 163 AU tolerance, so Thu is eased by one set per exercise and one RPE point.

decisions.text: Tue of week 3 logged at RPE 9 against a planned 7: 531 AU against 413. The model has you starting Fri 349 AU of form below plan (tolerance 163 AU, half a typical session), so Fri loses one set per exercise and one RPE point.
decisions.say: Tue of week 3 came in at RPE 9 instead of 7, and the load model puts you 349 AU of form below plan going into Fri, more than the 163 AU tolerance, so Fri is eased by one set per exercise and one RPE point.

decisions.text: Thu of week 6 missed (Upper B). Its main lift, standing overhead press, moves to Fri for 2 sets in place of pallof press; the rest is not made up.
decisions.say: You missed Thu of week 6, so its main lift, standing overhead press, moves to Fri in place of pallof press, and the rest of that session is let go.
